title: Forward unit ledger
description: Records when a unit of work starts and ends in the rigorscope forward ledger by running `rigorscope unit-start` and `rigorscope unit-close`: a wave-start step skill (forward-ledger-start), a close step skill (forward-ledger-close) at wave end, and a plan:pre planner contribution (Mode quick and quick-full only) that asks the quick planner to put the two commands in the first and last task. Advisory and off by default; a missing line is shown as unrecorded, never as a failure. Source: rigorscope capabilities/forward-ledger.

forward_ledger.enabled.description: Record unit starts and ends in the rigorscope forward ledger. Off by default and per project: {"forward_ledger": {"enabled": true}} in a project's .planning/config.json turns the three steps and the quick planner contribution on for that project only; there is no global switch.
